Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] <command> [options]

Commands:
  list [--json]                                       List environments
  check [--fix] [--json]                              Check/repair host setup
  enter <env>                                         Open interactive shell in /home/workspace
  exec [--timeout <dur>] [--summary] <env> -- <cmd...> Run command in /home/workspace
  start <env>                                         Start environment
  stop <env>                                          Stop environment
  snapshot <env> [name]                               Create paired OS + /home/workspace snapshot
  snapshots <env> [--json]                            List snapshots and sizes
  restore <env> <snap> [--system-only|--workspace-only] [--yes]
                                                      Restore snapshot
  diff <env> [snap] [--json]                          Review /home/workspace changes
  run --ephemeral --from <tpl> [--keep-on-fail] -- <cmd...>
                                                      Run command in disposable clone
  ssh-config [env]                                    Print SSH config stanzas
  svc <env> <action> [unit] [--lines <n>] [--json]    Manage container services
  export-config <env> [--output <path>]               Export aibox.toml manifest
  up [path]                                           Provision/reconcile from aibox.toml
  healthcheck <env> [--url <t>|--set <t>|--off]       Probe service health & auto-restart
  backup-schedule <env> <daily|weekly|off> [--keep n] Schedule systemd user backups
  completions <bash|zsh|fish>                         Generate shell completions
  help [command]                                      Show help

Global options:
  --project <dir>                                     Select project directory containing aibox/ (default: ~/aibox)
  -h, --help                                          Show help

Exit codes:
  0  OK (or <cmd> exit code for exec)
  1  Operation failed
  2  Usage error
  3  Another AIBox background task is running
  4  Environment not found or is a template

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] list [--json]

List Incus environments managed by AIBox in JSON format.

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] check [--fix] [--json]

Run host diagnostics for Incus, bridge, KVM, GPU, and Btrfs snapshots.

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] enter <env>

Run pre-steps (auto-snapshot, allowlist refresh, start if stopped) and attach an interactive shell in /home/workspace.

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] exec [--timeout <dur>] [--summary] <env> -- <cmd...>

Run pre-steps and execute a non-interactive command in /home/workspace, returning its exit code.

Options:
  --timeout <dur>   Terminate the command after <dur> (e.g. 30s, 15m, 1h30m; max 24h)
  --summary         Print package, service, and port changes after the command

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] start <env>

Start <env> with AIBox auto-snapshot and network allowlist refresh rules.

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] snapshot <env> [name]

Create a paired OS container and /home/workspace Btrfs snapshot.

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] snapshots <env> [--json]

List snapshots with OS/workspace availability and sizes.

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] restore <env> <snap> [--system-only|--workspace-only] [--yes]

Restore an environment snapshot (with pre-restore workspace safety snapshot).

Usage: aibox [--project <dir>] diff <env> [snap] [--json]

Show /home/workspace file changes compared against a snapshot (default: latest).

out.errorMessage: exec requires '--' before the command: aibox exec <env> -- <cmd...>
--json is not supported for this command.

incus snapshot create dev auto-<TS>
incus config device get dev workspace path

set -e
cfg="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}"
mkdir -p "$cfg"
file="$cfg/user-dirs.dirs"
tmp="$file.aibox.$$"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
if [ -f "$file" ]; then
    awk -v line="$1" '
        BEGIN { replaced = 0 }
        /^[[:space:]]*XDG_DOWNLOAD_DIR=/ {
            if (!replaced) { print line; replaced = 1 }
            next
        }
        { print }
        END { if (!replaced) print line }
    ' "$file" > "$tmp"
else
    printf '%s' "$2" > "$tmp"
fi
mv "$tmp" "$file"
